title: Scout Reporter for Windows
intro: Every screen of this website, plus Scan search: set up a Player Search in Football Manager, press F9, and the players FM found, with your own squad, are in Players, Best XI, Squad and Staff a few seconds later. No view files and no CSV export.
screenshotAlt: The player list: every player scored on your weights or an FM27 role

get.title: Download
get.fallback: The installer is published on GitHub: Scout Reporter desktop releases. Download {file} from the newest one.
get.requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Football Manager 27 (27.0) or 26 (26.3), from Steam, Epic or Game Pass. A Mac version is planned.

install.title: Install
install.smartScreen: The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen says it is from an unknown publisher. Click More info, then Run anyway.
install.location: Choose where to install it. It adds a Start menu entry and a desktop shortcut.

use.title: Use
use.start: Start Football Manager and load your save. Keep Scout Reporter open next to it.
use.search: In FM, open Player Search (or Staff Search) and set your filters, for example Player's interest: Interested, to see only players who would join you.
use.scan: Press F9 (it works inside FM) or Scan search in the app. The players from the search and your own club appear in every screen. Scan save reads the whole save instead, no search needed.
use.hidden: Switch Use CA, PA and hidden attributes off if you would rather not see them. Scan again every few in-game months to follow growth on the Growth page.
use.admin: If Football Manager runs as administrator, run Scout Reporter as administrator too.

safe.title: Is it safe?
safe.reader: The app only reads Football Manager's memory; it never changes your game or your save. The only thing it asks the internet is whether GitHub has a newer version (you can turn that off); nothing about you or your save is sent. Scans stay on your PC, under {path}. The code is open on GitHub, and every release is built there by GitHub Actions. The memory reader is adapted from FMSuperScout (MIT licence).
safe.updates: After a big Football Manager patch the reader may need an update. The app warns when your game version differs from the one it was made for, and tells you when a new version is out: Update now installs it and keeps your settings, scans, weights and formations.

website: Rather not install anything? <link>Use the website with a CSV export</link>.
